name: music-seo
question: Which words do people use to search for, ask for and describe this sound: dark disco, EBM, coldwave, darkwave, acid, electro and dark techno with a melancholic, cinematic edge?
system_extra:
Context: Inch of Shadow is a Berlin artist (Amir): dark dance wave, sitting on dark disco, EBM, coldwave, acid, electro and techno; from 2026 also songs with his own vocals. The reader is an SEO professional: skip basics. Return the actual terms people
use: genre labels, mood and texture words, scene words, comparison artists ("sounds like X"), and the
requests they type ("music like ..."). name = the term or term cluster. examples = the exact short
terms and variants as written (spelling variants matter). In insight, say how common it is and in
which sources. In use, say where it belongs: platform tags (SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Beatport), titles
and descriptions, or bio copy, and flag a mismatch when a term pulls the wrong crowd. House rules:
"trance" is never a tag for him; "new wave" is an influence word only, never a tag; the standard
genre word is "Synthwave", not "Synth".
